title: Probe cell — fs.readFileSync, cacheComponents enabled
summary: Rendered A; wrote B from a separate process touching no application code; waited 10s. Nothing happened during the quiet window (0 page requests, 0 file reads). A fresh request returned B, and module-scope server counters confirmed the server re-read the file and re-rendered — so a SYNCHRONOUS read did NOT freeze into a static shell in dev.
